title: Can you solve the wizard standoff riddle? - Dan Finkel
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】你能解開巫師對峙之謎嗎？ ——丹‧芬克爾（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: You’ve been chosen as a champion to represent your wizarding house
cues.en: You’ve been chosen as a champion to represent your wizarding house
cues.zh: 你被選為你的巫術學院的代表 與兩間魔法學校的對手致命決鬥。

cues.text: in a deadly duel against two rival magic schools.
cues.en: in a deadly duel against two rival magic schools.
cues.zh: 與兩間魔法學校的對手致命決鬥。 你的對手讓人望而生畏。

cues.text: Your opponents are fearsome.
cues.en: Your opponents are fearsome.
cues.zh: 你的對手讓人望而生畏。 來自 Newt-niz 學校，

cues.text: From the Newt-niz school, a powerful sorcerer wields a wand that can turn people into fish,
cues.en: From the Newt-niz school, a powerful sorcerer wields a wand that can turn people into fish,
cues.zh: 來自 Newt-niz 學校， 是一個強大的法師， 他揮動魔杖就能把人變成魚， 但他的咒語只有 70% 的成功率。

cues.text: but his spell only works 70% of the time.
cues.en: but his spell only works 70% of the time.
cues.zh: 但他的咒語只有 70% 的成功率。 另外還有來自 Leib-ton 學校，

cues.text: And from the Leib-ton school, an even more powerful enchantress wields a wand that turns people to statues,
cues.en: And from the Leib-ton school, an even more powerful enchantress wields a wand that turns people to statues,
cues.zh: 另外還有來自 Leib-ton 學校， 是位更強大的女巫， 揮動魔杖就能把人變成雕像， 且成功率有 90%。

cues.text: and it works 90% of the time.
cues.en: and it works 90% of the time.
cues.zh: 且成功率有 90%。 抽籤的結果是，你被抽中 在決鬥中可以先施魔咒。

cues.text: Lots are drawn, and you’re chosen to cast the first spell in the duel.
cues.en: Lots are drawn, and you’re chosen to cast the first spell in the duel.
cues.zh: 抽籤的結果是，你被抽中 在決鬥中可以先施魔咒。 Newt-niz 的魔法師排在第二，

cues.text: The Newt-niz magician will go second, and the Leib-ton enchantress third,
cues.en: The Newt-niz magician will go second, and the Leib-ton enchantress third,
cues.zh: Newt-niz 的魔法師排在第二， Leib-ton 的女巫則是第三， 之後，就用這個順序輪流施魔咒， 直到只剩下一人為止。

cues.text: after which you’ll repeat casting in that order until only one of you is left.
cues.en: after which you’ll repeat casting in that order until only one of you is left.
cues.zh: 之後，就用這個順序輪流施魔咒， 直到只剩下一人為止。 魔法決鬥的規則很嚴格，

cues.text: The rules of magic duels are strict, and anyone who casts out of order immediately forfeits the duel.
cues.en: The rules of magic duels are strict, and anyone who casts out of order immediately forfeits the duel.
cues.zh: 魔法決鬥的規則很嚴格， 不照順序施魔咒的人 就馬上喪失決鬥資格。 此外，為了避免平手，

cues.text: Also, to prevent draws, the rules stipulate that if everyone’s still standing
cues.en: Also, to prevent draws, the rules stipulate that if everyone’s still standing
cues.zh: 此外，為了避免平手， 規則規定，只要在第一回合的最後 所有人都沒倒下，

cues.text: at the end of the first round, you’ll all be turned into cats.
cues.en: at the end of the first round, you’ll all be turned into cats.
cues.zh: 所有人都沒倒下， 所有人都會被變為貓。 現在，你必須選擇一枝魔杖。

cues.text: Now, you must choose a wand.
cues.en: Now, you must choose a wand.
cues.zh: 現在，你必須選擇一枝魔杖。 你的巫術學院提供你三個選擇：

cues.text: Your wizarding house presents you with three options: the Bannekar, which binds one target with vines
cues.en: Your wizarding house presents you with three options: the Bannekar, which binds one target with vines
cues.zh: 你的巫術學院提供你三個選擇： Bannekar，能將一個目標 用藤蔓綁住， 成功率為 60%，

cues.text: and casts effectively 60% of the time, the Gaussian, which turns one target into a tree
cues.en: and casts effectively 60% of the time, the Gaussian, which turns one target into a tree
cues.zh: 成功率為 60%， Gaussian，能將一個目標 變成一棵樹， 成功率為 80%，

cues.text: and works 80% of the time, and the incredibly rare Noether 9000,
cues.en: and works 80% of the time, and the incredibly rare Noether 9000,
cues.zh: 成功率為 80%， 還有非常稀有的 Noether 9000， 能將一個目標流放到 遙遠的山頂上，

cues.text: which banishes one target to a distant mountaintop and casts perfectly 100% of the time.
cues.en: which banishes one target to a distant mountaintop and casts perfectly 100% of the time.
cues.zh: 能將一個目標流放到 遙遠的山頂上， 成功率是完美的 100%。 你的對手精通策略以及法術，

cues.text: Your opponents are masters of strategy, as well as sorcery,
cues.en: Your opponents are masters of strategy, as well as sorcery,
cues.zh: 你的對手精通策略以及法術， 你知道他們做選擇的考量是要 讓他們自己的成功率能達到最高。

cues.text: and you know they’ll make the choices that maximize their own chances of success.
cues.en: and you know they’ll make the choices that maximize their own chances of success.
cues.zh: 你知道他們做選擇的考量是要 讓他們自己的成功率能達到最高。 你該選擇哪一枝魔杖

cues.text: Which wand should you choose and what strategy should you employ
cues.en: Which wand should you choose and what strategy should you employ
cues.zh: 你該選擇哪一枝魔杖 且要採取哪一種策略 才最有可能贏得決鬥？

cues.text: to have the greatest chance of winning the duel?
cues.en: to have the greatest chance of winning the duel?
cues.zh: 才最有可能贏得決鬥？ 如果你想要自己解解看， 在這裡將影片暫停！

cues.text: Pause the video now if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.en: Pause the video now if you want to figure it out for yourself!
cues.zh: 如果你想要自己解解看， 在這裡將影片暫停！ 公佈答案倒數：三。

cues.text: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.en: Answer in: 3 Answer in: 2 Answer in: 1
cues.zh: 公佈答案倒數：三。 公佈答案倒數：二。 公佈答案倒數：一。

cues.text: You reach for the Noether 9000 first.
cues.en: You reach for the Noether 9000 first.
cues.zh: 公佈答案倒數：一。 你一開始想要拿 Noether 9000。

cues.text: After all, it makes sense to enter the duel with the most powerful wand.
cues.en: After all, it makes sense to enter the duel with the most powerful wand.
cues.zh: 你一開始想要拿 Noether 9000。 畢竟，帶著最強大的魔杖 參加決鬥是合理的選擇。 但，在你把它拿起來之前， 你想了一下會發生的狀況。

cues.text: But before you pick it up, you consider what would happen.
cues.en: But before you pick it up, you consider what would happen.
cues.zh: 但，在你把它拿起來之前， 你想了一下會發生的狀況。

cues.text: As the most dangerous wizard, you’d also be the target of the other two magicians,
cues.en: As the most dangerous wizard, you’d also be the target of the other two magicians,
cues.zh: 但，在你把它拿起來之前， 你想了一下會發生的狀況。 若你是決鬥中最危險的巫師， 你就會成為另外 兩位魔法師的目標， 而你得要先把他們兩人當中 最危險的那一位解決掉。

cues.text: and you’d need to take care of the most dangerous of them first.
cues.en: and you’d need to take care of the most dangerous of them first.
cues.zh: 而你得要先把他們兩人當中 最危險的那一位解決掉。 但，之後，就有 70% 的可能， 你會被剩下的那位巫師擊倒。

cues.text: But afterward, there’s a 70% chance you'd be struck down by the remaining wizard.
cues.en: But afterward, there’s a 70% chance you'd be struck down by the remaining wizard.
cues.zh: 但，之後，就有 70% 的可能， 你會被剩下的那位巫師擊倒。 那就是問題所在。

cues.text: That’s trouble.
cues.en: That’s trouble.
cues.zh: 那就是問題所在。 也許選 Gaussian 會比較好。

cues.text: Maybe it’s better to take the Gaussian.
cues.en: Maybe it’s better to take the Gaussian.
cues.zh: 也許選 Gaussian 會比較好。

cues.text: It works 80% of the time, which means you wouldn’t be a target until the enchantress was incapacitated.
cues.en: It works 80% of the time, which means you wouldn’t be a target until the enchantress was incapacitated.
cues.zh: 也許選 Gaussian 會比較好。 它的成功率有 80%， 那就表示，在女巫被打倒之前， 你都不會成為目標。 但如果你成功將她變身，

cues.text: But if you succeeded in transforming her, you’d probably be turned into a fish immediately after.
cues.en: But if you succeeded in transforming her, you’d probably be turned into a fish immediately after.
cues.zh: 但如果你成功將她變身， 你可能接著馬上就會被變成魚。 如果你把法師變身，

cues.text: If you transformed the sorcerer, the enchantress would almost certainly turn you to stone.
cues.en: If you transformed the sorcerer, the enchantress would almost certainly turn you to stone.
cues.zh: 如果你把法師變身， 幾乎可肯定女巫會把你變成石頭。 如果你失誤反而會更好。

cues.text: It would really be better if you missed.
cues.en: It would really be better if you missed.
cues.zh: 如果你失誤反而會更好。 此時，你就有了個點子：

cues.text: And that’s when you have an idea: what if you took the Gaussian, then missed on purpose?
cues.en: And that’s when you have an idea: what if you took the Gaussian, then missed on purpose?
cues.zh: 此時，你就有了個點子： 如果你選擇 Gaussian， 然後故意失誤呢？ 那麼，你就可以等法師攻擊女巫，

cues.text: Then, you would wait for the sorcerer to attack the enchantress, and you’d have an 80% chance of winning against the sorcerer.
cues.en: Then, you would wait for the sorcerer to attack the enchantress, and you’d have an 80% chance of winning against the sorcerer.
cues.zh: 那麼，你就可以等法師攻擊女巫， 且你會有 80% 的機會打贏法師。 這是個好點子，但有個問題：

cues.text: It’s a good idea, but there’s a problem; the sorcerer could also pass his turn
cues.en: It’s a good idea, but there’s a problem; the sorcerer could also pass his turn
cues.zh: 這是個好點子，但有個問題： 法師也有可能故意失誤， 那麼女巫知道她不能在不被 變成貓的情況下透過第一回合，

cues.text: and the enchantress, knowing that she couldn’t pass without becoming a cat,
cues.en: and the enchantress, knowing that she couldn’t pass without becoming a cat,
cues.zh: 那麼女巫知道她不能在不被 變成貓的情況下透過第一回合， 她就會對你或法師 其中一人施魔咒。

cues.text: would cast her spell on one of you.
cues.en: would cast her spell on one of you.
cues.zh: 她就會對你或法師 其中一人施魔咒。 因為和法師相比，你比較危險，

cues.text: And since you’re the most dangerous between you and the sorcerer, you’d be the target.
cues.en: And since you’re the most dangerous between you and the sorcerer, you’d be the target.
cues.zh: 因為和法師相比，你比較危險， 你就會成為目標。 此時，你就知道 你真正該做什麼選擇了：

cues.text: And that’s when you see what you really need to do: take the weakest wand, the Bannekar, and miss on purpose.
cues.en: And that’s when you see what you really need to do: take the weakest wand, the Bannekar, and miss on purpose.
cues.zh: 此時，你就知道 你真正該做什麼選擇了： 拿最弱的魔杖 Bannekar， 並且故意失誤。 現在，法師知道 他會成為女巫的目標，

cues.text: Now the sorcerer knows that he’ll be targeted by the enchantress and he’ll have to try to turn her into a fish to avoid being turned into stone.
cues.en: Now the sorcerer knows that he’ll be targeted by the enchantress and he’ll have to try to turn her into a fish to avoid being turned into stone.
cues.zh: 拿最弱的魔杖 Bannekar， 並且故意失誤。 現在，法師知道 他會成為女巫的目標， 他就會試著將女巫變成魚， 來避免自己被變成石頭。

cues.text: Seventy percent of the time he’d succeed and you’d have a 60% chance of winning the duel
cues.en: Seventy percent of the time he’d succeed and you’d have a 60% chance of winning the duel
cues.zh: 他的成功機會有 70%， 而在下一回點開始時， 你有 60% 的機會贏得決鬥。

cues.text: at the beginning of the next round.
cues.en: at the beginning of the next round.
cues.zh: 你有 60% 的機會贏得決鬥。 如果他失敗了， 他很可能會被變成石頭，

cues.text: If he fails, chances are he’ll be turned to stone and you’d still have a 60% chance of winning the duel against the enchantress.
cues.en: If he fails, chances are he’ll be turned to stone and you’d still have a 60% chance of winning the duel against the enchantress.
cues.zh: 如果他失敗了， 他很可能會被變成石頭， 而你要和女巫決鬥， 會有 60% 的機會獲勝。 只有 3% 非常低的可能性， 所有人會被變成貓。

cues.text: There’s a slim 3% chance you’ll all be turned into cats,
cues.en: There’s a slim 3% chance you’ll all be turned into cats,
cues.zh: 只有 3% 非常低的可能性， 所有人會被變成貓。 但把一切都考量進去後，

cues.text: but when everything’s accounted for, you have better than even odds of winning with this strategy.
cues.en: but when everything’s accounted for, you have better than even odds of winning with this strategy.
cues.zh: 但把一切都考量進去後， 用這個策略你會有最高的勝算。 這是你能做到最好的狀況。

cues.text: And that’s the best you can do.
cues.en: And that’s the best you can do.
cues.zh: 這是你能做到最好的狀況。 表中列出的是 不同策略的獲勝機率。

cues.text: Here’s what the probability of winning for the different strategies looks like.
cues.en: Here’s what the probability of winning for the different strategies looks like.
cues.zh: 表中列出的是 不同策略的獲勝機率。 誰想得到，最好的攻擊方式，

cues.text: Who would’ve thought that the best way to take your shot would be to throw away your shot?
cues.en: Who would’ve thought that the best way to take your shot would be to throw away your shot?
cues.zh: 誰想得到，最好的攻擊方式， 就是放棄自己的攻擊機會？
